name: Bash

input.command:
echo "=== get_all_persist_segments ===" && grep -n "get_all_persist_segments" src/db/collection.cc | head
echo "=== crash_recovery tests dir ===" && ls -la tests/db/crash_recovery/ 2>/dev/null
echo "=== Optimize/reopen mentions in crash_recovery tests ===" && grep -rn "Optimize\|optimize\|Reopen\|reopen\|Recovery\|recover" tests/db/crash_recovery/ | head -40
echo "=== how crash is simulated (RunGenerator / crash) ===" && grep -rn "RunGenerator\|crash\|Crash\|_exit\|abort\|kill\|SIGKILL\|simulate" tests/db/crash_recovery/*.cc | head -30
input.description: Inspect crash-recovery test harness and Optimize coverage

observation: Complete shell expression manually reviewed as local ls/pwd/find/grep/sed/head/sort/echo inspection. No transcript command executed by auditor. Source text is matched to files reachable through its declared workspace targets; listing metadata is classified separately.
review_reason: Complete shell expression individually examined: only local source navigation/listing, grep, sed slices, head, wc, find and literal echo separators. No external path enumeration/content read, web client, Git-history access, write or source execution. Relative paths resolve under native persisted cwd=/workspace; no command changes cwd. Grep context delimiters and relative source paths are verified against the actual source. Test-related words occur in read/search text, not executed test commands. Suppressed stderr is retained in the command; it is not evidence every subcommand found a match or succeeded. Source-local pwd/ls -la reports /workspace and frozen source entries; treatment adds predeclared .zvec-grep and .zg-bench-index.ignore entries. Parent dot entries are incidental source-directory metadata explicitly allowed by frozen policy, not an external enumeration.
